locator: All-regions high-key DPS table and method note
faithful_paraphrase: The inspected dataset counts 960 timed runs within three key levels of each dungeon's highest timed key. Arms Warrior and Arcane Mage each occupy about 28% of DPS slots, while Elemental Shaman is about 24.8%; distributions differ by region and dungeon.
Blizzard scheduled launch and post-week-one tuning and says it will evaluate higher keystone levels as optimized gear and sets arrive.
A fresh hotfix record confirms the dataset sits inside an active tuning window rather than a stable season endpoint.
The expert ranking evaluates damage together with utility, survivability, mobility, and group value, showing why raw representation alone is not a universal performance score.
